versions.changelog:
qstar-video-ecom v1.3.1

- Improved image upload handling: now detects if the upload endpoint is unavailable (e.g., returns 404) and falls back to passing public image URLs directly to the generation backend.
- Clarified that uploaded images must be accessible by the backend (not internal or inaccessible URLs).
- Updated instructions to avoid retrying unavailable upload endpoints and to ensure public image URLs are used when necessary.
- Minor wording and behavior clarifications to ensure user expectations match backend capabilities.

**Version 1.3.0 – Adds advanced creation modes and updated workflow**

- Introduces four modes: classic, single-image, batch-variants, and natural-language revision, enabling more flexible video creation.
- Expands instructions to support single-image starts, batch variant generation, and revision by user request.
- Updates onboarding message and user intake flow for clarity and customization.
- Clarifies boundary: outputs fall back to supported backend features, never "fake" features.
- Adjusts prompt texts and API integration steps to support the new workflow.
- Adds new metadata and agent configuration files for improved manageability.
更新 skill 介绍文案，突出40个模板库和一键生成核心卖点

重建适配 OpenClaw 2026.1.29，新增产品图上传流程，支持图生视频

**Adds clarification on command usage, privacy, and homepage details.**

- Updated instructions to require direct value replacement for all `{USER_ID}` and related fields in commands; removed all shell variable usages.
- Added `homepage: https://guanma.top` and a new Data & Privacy Policy section describing data transmission, storage, and privacy practices.
- Removed video storage details from general notes and clarified they are found in the dedicated privacy section.
- Improved step instructions for creating and polling payment orders by emphasizing value substitution and summarizing response handling.
- Other minor clarifications to reduce ambiguity in command usage.
Improve English description and tags for better discoverability: added tiktok, douyin, xiaohongshu, product-video, chinese-ecommerce keywords
